The '''Doge's Palace''' on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], also known as the '''Imperial palace''', was the residence of [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]], leader of the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Malastarian council]].

==Description==
The palace overlooked a large, open plain where fuel refineries were maintained by the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]. It had at least one balcony, where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]] conferred with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]].<ref name="TZB" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] took place in front of the palace, as a large [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army moved to take it and force a surrender, engaging the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] and their supporting Dug [[Dug rail gun/Legends|artillery]] and [[Dug cavalier/Legends|cavalry]]. However, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine authorized the use of the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which deactivated all droids and vehicles on the battlefield as well as communications equipment and other machines inside the building.<ref name="TZB" />
